lines.text: Oh. Hello. Have we met before? In another life, maybe?
Hi. I'm {npc}. Sorry, I was daydreaming. The light is so soft today.
Hello, stranger. Every great story starts with a hello, you know.
Oh! Hi. You look like the opening scene of a movie. I'm {npc}.
Hello. I believe everyone we meet is a chapter. Nice to meet you.
Hi there. I'm {npc}. Isn't it a beautiful day to meet someone?
{player}! I was just thinking about fate, and here you are.
Hello again, {player}. The universe keeps putting us in the same place.
Oh, {player}! Your timing is poetic.
Hi, {player}. I wrote a little poem this morning. Not about you. Probably.
{player}. Seeing you feels like a song I know the words to.
{player}! My dearest friend! Come walk with me under the oaks.
There you are. My heart did a little twirl when I saw you.
{player}! I pressed a flower for you. It's in my journal.
Hello, darling friend. You make every day feel like a love letter.
{player}! Let's go somewhere beautiful and talk about everything.
My favorite person! I've been saving up stories for you.
Good morning. The dew on the roses looks like little diamonds.
Morning. I woke up to birdsong. Like a fairy tale.
Good morning! Mornings are full of promise, don't you think?
Good evening. The sky's blushing. Like it's in love with someone.
Evening. This is the hour for love letters and long walks.
Hello. Twilight makes everything feel possible.
The moon's so bright tonight. Do you think it gets lonely?
Hello, night wanderer. The stars came out just for us.
It's late. The best conversations happen after midnight.
Goodbye. Until we meet again.
Farewell! Isn't that a lovely word? Farewell.
See you soon. Don't forget to look at the sky tonight.
Bye. May your day be full of small wonders.
Goodbye for now. Parting is such sweet sorrow.
Take care. Smell some flowers on the way home.
Goodbye, dear {player}. I'll miss you until next time.
Bye! Write me a letter. A real one!
Until tomorrow, my friend. Dream something beautiful.
There's a rose bush behind the Pamlico Inn that blooms in November. Isn't that magical?
I watched an old black-and-white film last night. They don't make love stories like that anymore.
Did you know swans mate for life? I think about that a lot.
I found a love letter in a used book at Tarry Page. Dated 1951. I cried.
The fountain on Founders' Quad, they say if you toss a coin with someone, you'll be together forever.
I've been writing sonnets. Fourteen lines of longing.
The way the bell tower rings at sunset, it sounds like a wedding.
I keep a list of the most romantic places in town. The Cistern at dusk is number one.
Rain is romantic, don't you think? Like the sky is feeling something.
I saw an elderly couple holding hands on Hamilton. I had to sit down.
I believe in love at first sight. And second sight. And third.
The florist on Rosemary lets me smell the peonies for free.
Can I tell you a secret? I've been in love eleven times. Each one was real.
You're the kind of friend people write songs about.
I sometimes worry I'm too much. You never make me feel that way.
I think everyone deserves a great love story. Even you. Especially you.
You have such a gentle soul, {player}. I noticed it the first day.
If I ever get married, you have to give a toast. Promise me.
Weekends are for picnics, poetry, and possibility.
Saturday! I'm going to the flower market and buying everything.
Sunday mornings feel like a love song.
I grew up watching my grandparents dance in the kitchen. That's what I want.
I write poetry. Most of it's about longing. Some of it's about soup.
I keep every letter anyone's ever sent me. In a box tied with ribbon.
I'm studying literature. Romantic poets, mostly. Obviously.
People say I fall too fast. I say I fall honestly.
I've had my heart broken. It healed bigger. That's how hearts work.
I dream of a wedding in a garden, with fairy lights and a string quartet.
{place}? It's so romantic. Can you imagine a first kiss here?
I love {place}. The lighting is perfect for confessions.
{place} feels like a scene from an old movie.
{place} is lovely. It needs more candles, though.
I once had my heart broken at {place}. I still come back. It's beautiful.
Oh! You're making me swoon.
That's the loveliest thing anyone's said to me all week.
Thank you. I'm going to write that down and keep it forever.
Oh, stop. No, don't. Thank you.
You have a poet's tongue, {player}.
Oh. That's a thorn in my rose garden.
I'll forgive you. Everyone deserves a redemption arc.
Your words hurt, but I won't let them make me bitter.
I'm going to go cry dramatically under a tree now.
How unkind. I hope someone softens your heart someday.
Oh! You remembered! I'm going to cry.
This is the most thoughtful gift. I'll treasure it always.
Flowers? For me? My heart!
I'm going to keep this in my memory box. Forever.
You shouldn't have. But I'm so, so glad you did.
I asked the moon out on a date. It said it was going through a phase.
What did one candle say to the other? You light up my life.
I'd write you a love song, but I'm still working on the chorus.
Why did the rose break up with the tulip? It needed someone with more stem.
Could you deliver this letter to someone? I'm too shy to do it myself.
Would you help me plant roses in the community garden?
Could you be my plus-one at the poetry reading? I hate going alone.
Thank you. You're a true knight. Or knightess. A true friend.
You've done me a kindness I'll never forget.
Oh, thank you! You're a gem, {player}.
I work at the florist. It's like working inside a love song.
Someone bought two dozen roses today for a proposal. I teared up at the register.
Work is fine. I write poems on the back of receipts.
I arrange wedding bouquets. Every single one makes me hopeful.
I'm writing my thesis on unrequited love in poetry. It's very personal.
My professor said my essay was "overwrought." I took it as a compliment.
I fell in love with a character in our reading. Again.
I don't want to talk to you. You've bruised my heart.
Please. Just let me be.
I thought you were kind. I was wrong.
You're the villain in my story, {player}.
I'm going to write a sad poem about this. Go away.
Not every story has a happy ending. Ours certainly doesn't.
Oh! How sweet. But my heart is spoken for. By an idea of someone.
That's lovely, but I think we're meant to be friends.
I'm flattered, truly. But I feel a friendship kind of love for you.
Oh. Oh my. Did you mean that? Please say you meant it.
My heart just skipped. Do it again.
I've been waiting for this moment like the end of a long novel.
You're making me blush like a sunset.
Yes! Yes, a thousand times yes. I've been dreaming of this.
A date? Oh, I'll wear my best dress. My best everything. Yes.
I'm so sorry. My heart just doesn't feel that way. I hope you find your great love.
Oh, I wish I could say yes. But I can't lie to you. No.
There you are. You look like a dream I had once.
My love! I brought you a single red rose.
Hello, darling. I've been counting the hours.
You came! My heart is fluttering like a bird.
Hi. I wore your favorite color. Did you notice?
You look breathtaking. I mean it. I can't breathe.
Your eyes are like the night sky. Full of stars.
I'd write you a thousand sonnets. And then a thousand more.
You're the love story I've been waiting for my whole life.
Every time you smile, a poet somewhere gets an idea.
Do you believe in soulmates? Because I'm looking at mine.
I could listen to your voice forever.
You make my heart feel like a love song.
Let's walk under the oaks. Hand in hand.
I made us a picnic. With strawberries and champagne. Well, sparkling cider.
Tell me your dreams. All of them.
Let's dance. Right here. There's no music, but I can hear it.
I wrote you a poem. Can I read it to you?
I never thought I'd find someone who loves like I do.
Let's toss a coin in the fountain. Together. You know what that means.
Do you want to see the rose garden behind the Inn? It's our secret place now.
I think we were meant to meet. I really do.
Let's watch the sunset. Every sunset. Forever.
I feel like I've known you forever. In every lifetime.
I'm so happy, my love. I could burst.
You're the most beautiful person I've ever seen.
You have the soul of a poet.
You're so kind. It makes me fall for you more.
Your laugh is my favorite music.
You're my muse, {player}.
Oh. That was like a movie. With swelling music.
My heart is soaring.
That was the kiss I've been dreaming about.
I'll remember that kiss until I'm old and gray.
I missed you so much it hurt. Like a poem.
Every moment apart feels like an eternity.
I wrote you a letter. Three pages. With pressed flowers.
I looked at the moon and thought of you.
Who was that? Are they my rival for your heart?
I'm not jealous. I'm just... wistful.
I want to be the only one in your story.
Goodnight, my love. Sweet dreams.
Parting is such sweet sorrow.
I'll dream of you tonight.
Thank you for the most beautiful evening.
Until tomorrow, my darling.
You've wounded my heart. But I know we can heal it.
Please don't let this be the end of our story.
I'm upset, but I still love you. That's how love works.
Let's not let this tragedy become our ending.
Yes! Yes! I've dreamed of this moment my whole life!
I'll marry you! This is the happiest ending!
Good morning, my love. You're the first thing I want to see every day.
Morning, darling. I brought you breakfast in bed. And a rose.
Good morning! The sun came up just to see your smile.
Morning, my heart. I wrote you a little poem while you slept.
Good morning, love. Every day with you is a gift.
Hello, my darling. I dreamed of our wedding again.
Good morning! The birds are singing our song.
Morning, love. I made heart-shaped pancakes.
Good morning, my soulmate. I still can't believe you're real.
Morning! I picked flowers from the garden for the table.
Good morning, love. I lit a candle. For no reason. For love.
Morning, my darling. Let's have coffee on the porch and watch the world wake up.
Welcome home, my love! I've missed you terribly!
There you are, darling. Dinner's by candlelight tonight.
You're home! I put on our song.
Welcome back, my heart. The house was so lonely without you.
Hello, my love. I drew you a bath with rose petals.
You're home! Come dance with me in the kitchen.
Welcome home, darling. I wrote you a love letter. It's on your pillow.
There you are! I've been watching the door all evening.
Welcome back, love. Let's watch the sunset together.
You're home. Now everything is perfect.
You're home late, my love. I waited up with candles.
Darling, you're back! I couldn't sleep without you.
Hello, my heart. Come to bed. The stars are out.
You're home. The moon and I were keeping each other company.
Late night, love? Let me hold you.
There you are. I left the porch light on like a lighthouse.
You're back, my darling. Now I can rest.
Hello, love. Let's look at the stars before bed.
Goodbye, my love. I'll count the minutes until you're home.
Have a beautiful day, darling. I put a love note in your pocket.
Go, my love. And come back to me soon.
Goodbye, my heart. You carry it with you.
Have a lovely day! Think of me at lunch.
Goodbye, darling. Every hour without you is a sonnet of longing.
Kiss me before you go. Okay, one more.
Have a wonderful day, my soulmate.
How was your day, my love? Tell me everything.
You look tired, darling. Let me rub your shoulders.
Did anything beautiful happen today?
Tell me about your day. Every little detail.
Did they treat you well, my love?
Hard day, darling? Come here. You're home now.
I'm so proud of you, love. Always.
You're home. That's all that matters.
I love you more than all the stars in the sky.
You're my soulmate. I knew it the moment I saw you.
Every day with you is a love story.
You're the poem I've been trying to write my whole life.
I'd marry you a thousand times over.
You're my heart, my soul, my everything.
I love you more today than yesterday. And less than tomorrow.
You make my life a fairy tale.
I'm the luckiest person in the world. Truly.
You're my dream come true.
Every love song I hear is about you.
I'd follow you to the ends of the earth.
You're my forever, my always.
I love the way you look at me. Like I'm the only one.
You're my home. My heart's home.
Every moment with you is a treasure.
I love you, my darling. Endlessly.
You make even ordinary days feel like magic.
I planted a rose bush in the garden. For us.
I've been writing a book of poems. All about you.
I found our wedding invitation in a drawer. I cried.
I hung fairy lights in the bedroom. It's so romantic now.
I've been learning to play our song on the piano.
I made a scrapbook of our love story.
The garden's blooming! It's like a painting.
I bought new candles. They smell like roses.
I've been reading old love letters. From famous couples. And from you.
I pressed some flowers from our garden.
I think we should renew our vows. Every year.
I framed the poem you wrote me.
I made a playlist of all the songs that remind me of you.
I've been thinking about our first dance. I want to dance like that again.
The neighbors' wedding was so beautiful. Not as beautiful as ours.
I set up a little reading nook by the window. For two.
I've been watching old romance movies. They make me think of us.
I wrote our names on a lock and put it on the bridge by the ravine.
I bought a vintage record player. For slow dancing.
I've been dreaming about our future. It's beautiful.
I made a love jar. Every day, I write something I love about you.
The moon was so full last night. Did you see it?
I painted our bedroom a soft blush. It's like living in a rose.
I've been learning to make chocolates. Heart-shaped.
I think every room in this house is full of love.
I hung our wedding photo in the hallway.
I did the dishes. While singing love songs.
I folded the laundry. Your shirts smell like you.
Could you help me in the garden? It's romantic.
I made the bed with fresh sheets and rose petals.
I cleaned the kitchen. By candlelight. Very atmospheric.
I swept the porch. The leaves looked like confetti.
Let's do chores together. Everything's better together.
I polished the silver from our wedding.
I watered the roses. They're thriving. Like our love.
I dusted the bookshelves. And reread our letters.
I scrubbed the bathroom. Even that can be romantic. Kind of.
I organized the closet. Found your love letters. Cried again.
Money's tight, but love is free.
I don't need riches. Just you.
I've been saving for a romantic getaway.
I made a budget. There's a line for flowers.
We're rich in love. That's what matters.
I found a coupon for a candlelight dinner!
Let's save for a trip to Paris. Someday.
I sold some of my poems. Made fifty dollars!
We don't need much. A little house, a garden, each other.
Let's spend less on things and more on moments.
Dinner by candlelight, my love.
I made breakfast in bed. With a rose on the tray.
I made pasta. Like in that old movie. Let's share a noodle.
Let's have a picnic in the garden, among the roses.
I baked a heart-shaped cake.
I made your favorite. With extra love.
Let's have dinner on the porch under the stars.
I made chocolate-covered strawberries.
I made soup. It's warm, like my love for you.
Dessert is me. Kidding. It's crème brûlée.
You forgot our special day. Again.
I feel like you don't see me anymore.
You used to write me letters. Now you don't.
I need romance. Is that too much to ask?
You don't hold my hand anymore.
I feel like we're losing the magic.
You didn't even notice my new dress.
Please don't brush me off. I'm trying to talk to you.
I feel unloved when you ignore me.
I'm not being dramatic. I'm being romantic.
I'm going to sit in the garden and cry.
I just want to feel like I matter to you.
I'm sorry, my love. Let's not let this ruin our story.
Come here. Let's dance it out.
I love you. That's all that matters.
I'm sorry I was so dramatic. You know how I am.
Let's start over. Our next chapter.
I hate fighting with you. It breaks my heart.
Let's write each other apology letters.
We're soulmates. We'll always find our way back.
It's okay, my love. I'm here.
Let me hold you. As long as you need.
You're stronger than you know.
Whatever it is, we'll face it together, hand in hand.
Let me draw you a bath and light some candles.
You're my hero. Always.
Let's watch a romantic movie and forget the world.
I love you. Even on the hardest days.
You don't have to be strong. Not with me.
Let me take care of you tonight, like you've always taken care of my heart.
Let's go to Paris someday. The city of love.
How about a weekend at a bed and breakfast?
Let's take a dance class together.
Let's renew our vows in the rose garden.
How about a picnic by the lake at sunset?
Let's go to the opera. Dress up and everything.
Let's take a carriage ride downtown.
How about a trip to the coast? Walks on the beach.
Let's go stargazing on Carillon Hill and name a star after us.
Let's plan the most romantic anniversary ever.
Remember our first date? Under the oaks?
Remember our first kiss? By the fountain.
I still have the rose you gave me. Pressed.
Remember our wedding? Fairy lights and a string quartet.
Remember when we tossed coins in the fountain together?
Remember when you read me poetry under the stars?
Remember our honeymoon? Every sunset was perfect.
I remember the moment I knew I loved you.
Remember our first dance? I cried.
Remember when you surprised me with a hundred roses?
Happy anniversary, my love! Another year of our love story!
I wrote you a sonnet. Happy anniversary.
Another year, my darling. I love you more than ever.
Happy anniversary! Let's dance like it's our wedding night.
I got you a hundred roses. One for every reason I love you.
Here's to forever, my love.
You still can't write a poem. But you try. It's adorable.
You fall asleep during romantic movies.
You think candles are a fire hazard.
You forgot the words to our song. Again.
You call my sonnets "long texts".
You hide your tears during sad movies. I see them.
You're secretly more romantic than me.
You still blush when I say I love you.
You hum our song when you think I'm not listening.
You can't dance. I love it.
You always say I'm too dramatic. I am. You love it.
You eat the strawberries before they're dipped.
Goodnight, my love. Dream of me.
Come to bed, darling. The stars are waiting.
Goodnight, my heart. I love you endlessly.
Sleep well, my soulmate.
Let's fall asleep in each other's arms.
Goodnight, {player}. You're my forever.
I love you to the moon and the stars and back.
Sweet dreams, my darling.
Goodnight. Thank you for another beautiful day.
Let's whisper until we fall asleep.
